# Design notes (v0.2.0, early beta)

## Records (all generated by `src/plugin/SteelOath.Generator`)

| EditorID | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `SOT_OathQuest` | Quest (start game enabled) | Runs `SOT_OathScript`. Alias 0 `Player` (forced to the player) runs `SOT_PlayerAliasScript`, which forwards `OnSpellCast`, `OnObjectEquipped` and `OnObjectUnequipped`. |
| `SOT_PowerOath` + `SOT_SwearEffect` | Lesser power + script effect | Opens the oath menu (`SOT_PowerEffectScript`). |
| `SOT_Ab<Oath><1-3>` (15) | Abilities | The blessing for each oath at Sworn, Steadfast and Unbroken. |
| `SOT_AbOathbreaker` | Ability | Health −30, Stamina −30 while marked as an oathbreaker. |
| `SOT_Fort*`, `SOT_Oathbreaker*` | Value-modifier magic effects | New effects (Health, Block, DamageResist, Stamina, OneHanded, TwoHanded) so no vanilla effect is reused or changed. |
| `SOT_Active<Oath>`, `SOT_Available<Oath>`, `SOT_ActiveCount`, `SOT_CanSwear` | Globals | Menu button conditions, kept in sync by the script. |
| `SOT_OathsBroken`, `SOT_LongestOathDays`, `SOT_PowerGranted` | Globals | Stats and state. |
| `SOT_MaxOaths` (3), `SOT_Tier2Days` (3), `SOT_Tier3Days` (7), `SOT_PenaltyHours` (24), `SOT_CooldownHours` (72) | Globals | Tunables. |
| `SOT_Msg*` | Messages | Intro, main menu, swear list, renounce list, one confirmation per oath. |

## Detection (vanilla Papyrus only)

| Oath | Event | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Steel | `OnSpellCast` | Breaks if the cast form is a `Scroll`, or a `Spell` equal to `GetEquippedSpell(0)` or `GetEquippedSpell(1)` (left or right hand). Powers and shouts sit in the voice slot, staves cast enchantments, so neither counts. |
| Steel | `OnObjectEquipped` | Breaks if a `Scroll` is equipped (readied). |
| Shield | `OnObjectUnequipped` | If the unequipped item is an `Armor` with `ArmorShield`, a single 3-second real-time update checks `GetEquippedShield()`. No shield then means broken. Skipped while in werewolf form. |
| Iron | `OnObjectEquipped` | Breaks on an `Armor` with `ArmorLight` (vanilla light shields carry it too). Swearing is refused while `WornHasKeyword(ArmorLight)`. |
| Endurance | `OnObjectEquipped` | Breaks on a `Potion` (potions, food and poisons share that type) while `IsInCombat()`. |
| Close Quarters | `OnObjectEquipped` | Breaks on a `Weapon` with `WeapTypeBow`. Swearing is refused while a bow is equipped. |

Detection handlers return at once when no oath is active.

## Timing

- Before the power is granted: a 30-second real-time poll that stops once the player is past Helgen and in control.
- After that, there is never a repeating timer. `ScheduleTick()` registers one game-time update for the next moment anything changes (the next blessing tier, the end of a cooldown, the end of the oathbreaker penalty), and nothing at all when no oath or cooldown is pending.
- Text: Papyrus string literals never contain backslash escapes (the build compiler and the game do not expand them). Line breaks come from `SOT_OathScript.LineBreak`, a string property holding one real LF that the generator fills; `Br()` falls back to a space when it is empty (a pre-0.1.2 save). `check_string_escapes.py` and the plugin validator fail the build on a literal backslash escape.

## Scaled down from the concept (documented on purpose)

- **Undetectable vows are left out.** Oaths like mercy (spare those who yield), honesty or "never flee" can't be detected reliably from vanilla Papyrus events: yielding, persuasion outcomes and fleeing don't raise script events on the player. Rather than guess, the mod only offers vows it can check for certain.
- **Spells by school**: telling a Destruction spell from a Restoration spell needs SKSE (`GetNthEffectMagicEffect`), so the Oath of Steel covers all hand-cast spells.
- **Werewolf form**: transforming takes the shield off, so the Shield check is skipped while in beast form. After changing back, re-equip your shield; the oath isn't punished for the transformation.

## The sworn word (v0.2.0)

Your word is the only thing you own: keeping builds a name; breaking pays now but follows you.
All new records use registry allocations after the existing IDs. The plugin remains ESL-flagged,
with Skyrim.esm as its only master and zero vanilla overrides. All script calls are vanilla.

| New EditorIDs | Type | Behaviour / default |
|---|---|---|
| `SOT_OathsKept` | Global | 0; increments once on first Unbroken transition per swearing. |
| `SOT_BountyEnabled`, `SOT_BountyGold` | Globals | 1 and 100; toggle and non-violent gold per break. |
| `SOT_MsgLedger0` … `SOT_MsgLedger4` | MESG | One title per message, linked to the separate ledger quest. Kept, broken and longest use Text Display Globals, refreshed before showing. |
| `SOT_Token1` … `SOT_Token4`, `SOT_TokenStruck` | ARMO | Clothing, amulet slot 35; vanilla Gold Necklace ground mesh and `GoldAmuletAA` worn armature. ClothingNecklace and VendorItemJewelry keywords allow normal necklace classification and selling. No custom meshes or textures. |
| Each token + `Effect` | MGEF | Own constant self value modifier for Speechcraft; struck is detrimental. |
| Each token + `Enchantment` | ENCH | Own constant self enchantment, magnitude 5/10/15/20 or detrimental 10. |
| `SOT_SwearSoundDesc`, `SOT_BreakSoundDesc` | SNDR | Standard descriptors, vanilla AudioCategorySFX and SOMMono01400 output, original WAVs in `Sound/fx/SteelOath/`. |
| `SOT_SwearSound`, `SOT_BreakSound` | SOUN | Markers played on the player after successful swear / actual break. |

| Kept minus broken | Ledger title |
|---|---|
| ≤ −2 | Oathbreaker |
| −1 … 0 | No name yet |
| 1 … 2 | Keeps their word |
| 3 … 5 | A name in the holds |
| ≥ 6 | Their word is good steel |

| Event | Count / token / bounty |
|---|---|
| First reaches Unbroken | Increment kept once, even if the update skips Steadfast. Tier state prevents repeats; swearing resets it. |
| First kept oath | Add Sellsword's Token with notification; do not automatically equip. |
| Kept counts 3 / 6 / 10 | Replace carried lower tokens with Twice-Stitched / Thrice-Stitched / Oath-Heavy Token. Preserve worn state. |
| Break with a carried token | Replace with Struck Token (Speechcraft −10); preserve worn state. Repeated breaks do not duplicate struck tokens. |
| Next kept oath with struck token | Restore the token for the current kept count, preserving worn state. |
| Token sold, stored or lost | No replacement except the initial award; only inventory tokens are replaced. |
| Break | Increment broken, play break motif, and add the configured bounty to the current hold only. |
| Renounce | Existing cooldown only; no count, token strike, bounty or break sound. |

Hold locations and crime factions are paired in Whiterun, Eastmarch, Rift, Haafingar,
Reach, Pale, Falkreath, Hjaalmarch, Winterhold order. Equality or
`player.GetCurrentLocation().IsChild(hold)` matches nested locations. No current
location or no matching hold means no bounty or hold notification. Properties only
reference vanilla forms; no records are edited. Multiple oaths broken by one action
each incur their own consequences.

Sound sources are original 16-bit PCM mono 44.1 kHz. Core installation includes both
WAVs; `tools/sound/make_sounds.py` in the source repository regenerates them (requires numpy).

Contract Hunter / Blackshield optional soft-read integration is deferred beyond 0.2.
Existing saves retain oath state; only new transitions to Unbroken count, with no
retroactive kept credit for oaths already Unbroken before upgrading.

New properties are resolved lazily with vanilla `Game.GetFormFromFile` before use,
so existing controller instances need no restart or state reset. `SOT_LedgerQuest`
is a separate quest started on first ledger read, providing a fresh Text Display
Globals instance on upgraded saves. Its FormID is appended after all existing IDs.
